name: Google Cloud Storage
summary: List, fetch and publish objects in Google Cloud Storage with a service account or Application Default Credentials, through the JSON API.

fields.name: service_account_json
fields.label: Service account key (JSON)
fields.help: Create it in the Google Cloud console; store it with ogun secrets set.

auth.label: Application Default Credentials on the daemon host

settings.name: project_id
settings.label: Project
settings.help: Only needed to bill requests to a project, for example for requester-pays buckets.

operators.summary: List objects under a prefix as a manifest.
Fetch objects into the artifact store, hashed with BLAKE3, resumable by range.
Publish artifacts under an object prefix with a resumable upload and a recorded digest.

notes: Staging bucket for BigQuery loads (see the BigQuery connector). Requests go to storage.googleapis.com; the bucket is part of the path.
